title: LLC Implementations Manager
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity, and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, Our Employees Set Out On a Mission To Unlock The Power Of Equity Ownership For More People In More Places. We Believe That The Problems We Solve Today Unlock The Opportunities Of Tomorrow. As An Implementations Specialist On The Alt Assets Team, You’ll Work To Build Strong Relationships With Our LLC And PE-backed Customers, Deliver Best-in-class Service To Our Customers, And Be The Voice Of Our Customers To Our Product Partners. You’ll Also

  • Effectively manage complex projects from inception to completion
  • Implement multi-phased projects and apply project management best practices.
  • Understand complex equity structures and represent them on the platform
  • Deliver white-glove customer service while fostering meaningful relationships with our clients to ensure that they get maximum value from our software
  • Manage complex datasets with high integrity
  • Train clients on how to use Carta LLC Software.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the onboarding process
  • Serve as a technical product expert to respond to queries from clients, the business, and other internal departments, collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Developer teams when necessary
  • Identify, recommend, test, and implement operational procedure improvements and take on additional projects to drive product improvement, engages with product teams as necessary
  • Contribute to the ongoing learning and success of the team/company by sharing knowledge through mentorship, collaboration, and thorough documentation
The Team You’ll Work With

We founded Carta LLC in 2019 with a mission to expand Carta’s total addressable market and acquire more nodes in the ownership graph outside Venture.

Carta LLC is Carta’s first step into alternative assets including Private Equity, Real Estate, Professional Services Organizations, Roll-ups, and other non-tech operating companies. To do this, Carta LLC must support the disparate equity structures, heavier reliance on documents, and multi-entity structures we see in these companies.

The Implementations team is responsible for onboarding LLCs or PE-backed companies onto the Carta platform. The team utilizes their advanced equity knowledge with exceptional client and project management skills to onboard companies and their data on the Carta platform.

About You

  • You have a demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems and offer creative solutions to meet customer needs. You possess a helpful and professional attitude and can exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • You care deeply, genuinely, and passionately about client services. You have great people skills and a high degree of empathy
  • You are proficient in Excel and have experience with CRMs (Preferably: Salesforce)
  • You are able to quickly learn and understand our SaaS platform configuration and troubleshoot system issues
  • You have strong project management skills - must be able to manage multiple onboarding projects (40+) at a time, while providing timely follow-up to clients. You are highly organized and can manage a group of C-Suite clients.
  • You are familiar or will become familiar with Private Equity, Capitalization, and LLC
  • Knowledge of finance and accounting is a plus. Experience learning new technologies, platforms, and systems is also a plus

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer for Ceph & Distributed Storage. As part of Cloud Engineering, you'll be building modelling software to drive systems such as OpenStack, Ceph, and Kubernetes with a focus on distributed storage and Ceph. You'll be engineering solutions to scale in production, working with our field teams to ensure we're meeting the needs of customers looking to adopt cutting-edge technology.
Applicants should be passionate about the future of the software defined datacenter, distributed systems, and open source. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.
This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.
Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or the Americas regions
What your day will look like

  • Write high quality, rigorously designed Python and Golang software
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation that define best practices for authoring high quality operators
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Develop and maintain software for delivery, operations and life-cycle management of Ceph storage
What we are looking for in you
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with writing modern, maintainable Python
  • You have experience with Ceph storage
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest and experience with two or more of the following: Linux, Kubernetes, Public cloud, OpenStack, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, Debian packaging
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience operating Ceph clusters in production
  • Experience with open source distributed storage such as Gluster, Minio, Mayastor or similar
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
ENGENHEIRA(O) ESPECIALISTA EM ATIVOS DE MINERAÇÃO – MINA E USINA – VAGA PREFERENCIAL PARA MULHERES

ENGENHEIRA(O) ESPECIALISTA EM ATIVOS DE MINERAÇÃO – MINA E USINA – VAGA PREFERENCIAL PARA MULHERES

Por que vagas preferenciais para mulheres?

A Vale está em uma jornada de transformação, na busca de se tornar uma empresa mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Além disso, acreditamos que o avanço em equidade de gênero contribui para a construção de um futuro melhor para todos. Queremos aumentar a representatividade de todas as mulheres: pretas, brancas, com qualquer identidade de gênero e orientação sexual ou que tenham algum tipo de deficiência.

Entendemos que iniciativas com foco em vagas preferenciais contribuem para avanços na criação de um ambiente cada vez mais colaborativo, inovador e atrativo para novos talentos. Por isso, valorizamos em diferentes ações e processos seletivos a participação de todos os diferentes perfis de candidatos e candidatas, nas diferentes dimensões de grupos que integram a agenda de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

O processo seletivo para esta posição segue o mesmo formato, etapas e formas de avaliação de outros programas de recrutamento da Vale.

Juntos, a gente transforma o futuro.

A Vale tem uma história de transformação. Na mineração, atuamos para transformar recursos naturais em prosperidade e desenvolvimento sustentável. Na segurança, buscamos aprender com o passado para evoluir diariamente e se tornar referência de confiabilidade.

Nossas pessoas fazem parte de toda esta jornada de transformação e evolução. Afinal, o nosso compromisso é com a vida. A Vale existe para melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro. Juntos.

Acreditamos que a mineração é essencial para o desenvolvimento do mundo e precisamos deixar um legado para o meio ambiente, para as comunidades em que estamos e para todas as vidas que tocamos.

Nos orgulhamos de empregar mais de 120 mil pessoas, em 30 países. Somente com esta força, nos tornamos a maior mineradora do mundo em minério de ferro, pelotas e níquel. Também atuamos nas áreas de logística, energia e siderurgia.

Quer conhecer nossa oportunidade?

Formação: Graduação Completa em Engenharia

Localidade: Nova Lima, Minas Gerais, Brasil

Horário de Trabalho: Diurno – Das 7:30 às 16:30

Período de inscrição: de 20/06/2023 a 26/06/2023

Como profissional, você vai...

  • Alavancar a cultura com implantação de melhorias para engenharia, confiabilidade, buscando aplicação de novas tecnologias para aumento da produtividade, sustentabilidade dos ativos e melhoria das condições operacionais;
  • Alavancar a confiabilidade operacional integrado com o time de Processos Operacionais de Mineração, Saúde de Usinas, visando alavancagem de UF, OEE e outros;
  • Entregar o programa orçamentário de custo referente ao Programa de Produtividade Ferrosos, atuando como sponsor e/ou líder técnico de squads para redução do custo de manutenção e produção;
  • Desdobrar, implantar e alavancar o processo de adequação e/ou revitalização de ativos utilizando como referência os Padrões Normativos Vale – PNRs;
  • Suportar e validar dos orçamentos operacionais (OPEX) e investimentos (CAPEX), referente as disciplinas que possuem correlação com Engenharia de Processos;
  • Desenvolver, disseminar e dar abrangência das estratégias e boas práticas para manutenção e operação;
  • Propiciar a otimização global dos ativos de usina aproveitando sinergias, ampliando a estratégias da cadeia produtiva e evoluindo os indicadores globais de processo e negócio;
  • Suportar tecnicamente em campo as operações referentes a soluções de engenharia, manutenção e operação;
  • Alavancar o programa Autônomos para Mineração (Mina e Usina), visando aumento de equipamento auto operadores, redução de headcount e redução de risco referente a segurança operacional;
  • Governar, otimizar, revisar e desdobrar dos Regulamentos Técnicos para Mineração e Pelotização;
  • Elaborar e implantar de iniciativas com foco em otimização Frota Ferrosos HME – Extensão da Vida Útil;
  • Atuar em iniciativas cross com demais áreas matriciais, com escopo em: Eficiência Energética Diesel e Eletricidade, Plano de Alavancagem de Especialistas, P&D Mineração, Agenda China e Alternativos.

Estamos muito felizes por ter alguém como você:

  • Graduação Completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em processos de mineração;
  • Conhecimentos em: confiabilidade, performance de ativos, performance de produção, custos e otimização de processos de manutenção e/ou operação;
  • Experiência em operações (vivência de campo em manutenção e/ou operação);
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e para acessar outros sites da empresa.

Como é trabalhar na Vale?

Para transformar o futuro temos de cuidar do presente. Apostamos em um ambiente cada vez mais aberto, em que as pessoas possam ser mais autônomas e buscar o seu desenvolvimento pessoal.

Criamos para os nossos colaboradores um portfólio de treinamentos e capacitações técnicas, de gestão e de liderança ou transversais. Acreditamos em quem faz a nossa empresa.

Solicitamos aos trabalhadores que se vacinem contra a COVID-19 e que apresentem o cartão de vacinação com os dados do imunizante, ou carteira de vacinação digital gerada pelo Conecte SUS.

Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
  • Facilitate release activities across all releases, mainly with ensuring quality, timely deployments across environments
  • Maintains the release schedule for all core services and ensure alignment across key partners and vendors.
  • Coordinate release content and effort based on the service request backlog, pending service requests, third party applications, or operating system updates
  • Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including QA plans, schedule, and scope changes.
  • Conduct Release Readiness reviews, Milestone Reviews, and Business Go/No-Go reviews with stakeholders
  • Produce Deployment, Run Books and Implementation Plans
  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)
  • Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists.
  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.
  • Understanding of Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus

  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams towards task completion
  • Demonstrated effective leadership and analytical skills
  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Quality Assurance Manager - Brazil
description:
Please note that for this position, candidates must be located in Brazil.

QA Manager

SUMMARY

The QA Manager leads a team of Quality Engineers and SEiTs responsible for testing multiple Accruent products and is a champion of Quality. They know good when they see it and motivate teams to achieve greatness. They work tirelessly to remove roadblocks to success, embrace a culture of continuous improvement and are always willing to teach others how to embrace it as well.

The ideal candidate will be highly motivated, possess leadership experience and have a deep knowledge of QA best practices. Ideally, they will have led a team before and have experience with automation, Agile software development and are comfortable leading teams located in multiple countries. Most importantly, they are a tireless advocate of doing it right the first time around and take great pride in the quality of the software they produce. If you have these attributes, are passionate about technology and are a proven problem solver then Accruent may be a fit for you.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be a tireless champion of software quality. This requires understanding how teams work, identifying where the quality gaps exist, negotiating with stakeholders to close them, and performing necessary training where required.
  • Working with a cross-team of stakeholders, deliver software updates within required timelines and according to organizational standards. Stakeholders include Product Management, Engineering, Support, Operations and Professional Services.
  • Provide leadership for a team of Quality Engineers inclusive of all management responsibilities such as goals, objectives, reviews, coaching, mentoring and career development.
  • Manage to a set of KPIs used to measure the success of the teams. When teams deviate from them, utilize internal tools to understand the reasons for deviation and take corrective actions.
  • Proactively engage with other leaders within Accruent to identify opportunities for improvement on the teams and compiles plans to achieve them.
  • Maintain and grow a robust automated regression suite to further product quality goals.
  • Embrace the adoption of a wide range of quality standards for stories and features including both functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Actively participate in the ITIL processes of Change Management, Problem Management & Release Management to identify ways to improve quality.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Fluent/Advanced English skills.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, STEM-related or Business-Related degree.
  • Experience in the software development industry.
  • Experience in Quality Assurance roles or responsibilities.
  • Experience leading a team of Quality Engineers.
  • Proven experience with software quality assurance best practices in an Agile environment.
  • Experience developing business cases to fund long-term priorities.
  • Understanding of risk-based testing and risk mitigation planning.
  • Ability to use metrics and data to holistically assess the state of quality for a product.
  • Experience with Agile software development methodology.
  • Experience designing and deploying automated testing suites.
  • Experience with performance testing techniques in an Agile environment.
  • Self-reliant and motivated self-starter.
  • Project and task oriented with a focus on details.

DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

  • Experience managing associates located in multiple countries.
  • Prior experience as a software engineer.
  • Experience with the Scaled Agile Framework.
  • Prior experience as a Scrum Master.
  • Experience using Jira to manage Agile software development.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS and DevOps concepts.
  • Exposure to the Agile SAFe Framework and Kanban techniques.
  • Knowledge of basic networking principles and concepts.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
The Canonical Public Cloud team is looking for enthusiastic engineers to be Ubuntu distribution engineers. Engineers working on the Ubuntu distribution will work closely with the Ubuntu Engineering organization to ensure technologies such as cloud specific agents, webservers, databases, and virtualization and containerization stacks are optimized for public clouds. CPC works closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google, IBM, and Oracle and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users. Working on the CPC team as a distro engineer means working closely with partners and with Ubuntu to make the best version of Ubuntu for the cloud.
Ubuntu Server is a platform that enables amazing technology the whole world over, and is the #1 operating system in the public clouds. Applicants to this role will have the opportunity to help with everything that goes into evolving Ubuntu. The Public Cloud team builds Ubuntu Server for cloud environments, maintaining extensive continuous deployment operations to deliver images to end users. You will get to work with our experienced team and have the benefits of learning and growing alongside the best engineers in the business.

  • Interest in containerization and virtualization such as Docker or OCI service containers, LXD system containers, and local virtualization like Virtualbox or QEMU, or Public Clouds

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. Site Reliability Engineer II - Guidewire Cloud Platform (Application)

Apply remote type Hybrid locations Brazil - Curitiba time type Full time posted on Posted 30+ Days Ago job requisition id JR_12509

Summary

At Guidewire, we deliver the software that Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance companies rely on to protect their customers during crises, natural disasters, accidents, and cyber risks. Our core applications enable insurers to sell and underwrite policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. We also offer a suite of innovative products for data management, digital portals, and predictive analytics. Hundreds of insurers worldwide use Guidewire's products, running on our cutting-edge Guidewire Cloud Platform, to handle billions of dollars in business. We are dedicated to providing the tools and technology that help insurers protect and support their customers when they need it most.


The Opportunity

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer III who is eager to contribute to the transformation of the insurance industry with our leading cloud platform. As a member of the SRE-Application team, you'll play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and scalability of applications running on our Guidewire Cloud Platform. This position offers a unique opportunity to apply your skills in automation, software engineering, and operational discipline to support our cloud-based solutions.

Job Description

What You'll Do

  • Assist in troubleshooting and resolving issues in collaboration with development teams, reducing customer impact.
  • Develop and maintain automated runbooks to address common issues proactively.
  • Apply engineering principles and basic automation to enhance our operating environments.
  • Monitor applications and help improve their reliability and performance on the Guidewire Cloud Platform.
  • Use your software engineering skills to optimize systems and reduce manual tasks.
  • Document incidents and assist in refining processes to prevent future occurrences.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, tools, and best practices in site reliability engineering.
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in on-call rotations to ensure the availability and reliability of our services.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience as an SRE or similar role, focusing on improving system reliability.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to assist in analyzing complex systems and devising effective solutions.
  • Effective collaboration and communication skills to work cross-functionally and document processes.
  • Experience with automation, monitoring, and performance optimization tools and techniques.
  • Commitment to maximizing uptime, scalability, and delivering an exceptional end-user experience.
  • Passion for technology and a desire to continuously learn and grow your skills.
  • Alignment with Guidewire's mission to leverage technology to help protect and support others.

Required Skills

  • Comfortable with Linux system administration and the ability to program/script using Python, Go, Java, shell, or equivalent.
  • Basic understanding of SLI's, SLO's, and Error Budgets.
  • Familiarity with application performance monitoring (APM) and telemetry tools.
  • Some experience with troubleshooting and debugging distributed systems on cloud infrastructure.
  • Exposure to CICD pipelines within K8S or legacy ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with creating monitors, dashboards, and synthetic transactions in monitoring tools like Datadog.
  • Some experience deploying and managing infrastructure within AWS or Kubernetes ecosystems using Terraform or other cloud-native approaches.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure configuration management using tools such as GitOps, Puppet, or Ansible.
  • Basic understanding of AWS cloud networking and security.

Preferred Skills

  • Pursuing or interested in pursuing SRE Certification.
  • Pursuing or interested in pursuing AWS Certification.
  • Familiarity with SQL, database administration, data pipelines, performance tuning, and schema design.
  • Exposure to pipelining tools such as Team City, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
  • Interest in learning about open-source distributed data processing frameworks such as Hadoop, Apache Spark, AWS RedShift, etc.

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

About Us

At Guidewire, we are utterly committed to customer success. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service to the P&C Insurance industry. Vaga para Moradores da GRANDE SÃO PAULO

Descrição

Realizar atendimento direto a clientes, prestar suporte ao time de vendas quando solicitado, prospectar e qualificar novos leads.

Foco principal: vender e ampliar progressivamente as vendas e a satisfação do cliente, do contato inicial ao fechamento de oportunidades. Buscar sempre alcançar as metas estabelecidas.

Responsabilidades Principais

Prospecção: identificar e qualificar potenciais clientes por meio de pesquisas e ferramentas internas; realizar contato inicial com leads qualificados; apresentar nossos produtos e nossa política de prestação de serviços de pré e pós-venda.

Atendimento: realizar atendimento ativo e receptivo, via telefone, e-mail ou chat; responder consultas, dúvidas e fornecer informações detalhadas sobre os produtos e prestação de serviços de pré e pós-venda; manter relacionamento contínuo com clientes para garantir acompanhamento adequado ao longo do processo de venda; assegurar-se de que clientes atendidos gerem novas oportunidades.

Suporte ao Time de Vendas: colaborar com espírito de equipe, enviar propostas, relatórios e atualizações de status de clientes; manter bom relacionamento com outros setores de pós-venda, administrativo ou marketing; facilitar processos de comunicação interna e com o mercado.

Negociação e Fechamento de Vendas: negociar condições comerciais, prazos e preços dentro das políticas da empresa; elaborar propostas comerciais claras e objetivas; acompanhar o processo de venda do início ao fim, focando na satisfação do cliente.

Gestão de Carteira de Vendas: manter e gerenciar uma carteira de clientes ativa, buscar novas oportunidades e nichos de mercado; acompanhar o pós-venda para garantir experiência positiva com nossos produtos e serviços.

title: Mid Level Software Test Engineer
description:
Software Test Engineer (Mid level)

Please note that this is currently a pipeline position. While we don't have an immediate opening for this role, we anticipate new opportunities arising soon. Our recruitment team is actively interviewing candidates and preparing them for our interview process. This approach allows us to build a pool of talented individuals ready to join our team when positions become available. By applying now, you'll be at the forefront when new openings emerge, potentially expediting your journey to joining our innovative team at Poatek.

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer expertise in eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our parent company.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. The model requires working in a hybrid mode from one of our offices in São Paulo (2 times/week or 8 days/month) or Porto Alegre (3 times/week or 12 days/month). Our WFN culture fosters in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with local and visiting team members from other global offices.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital is hiring empathetic, curious engineers to join our growing team. We work in a dynamic and fulfilling atmosphere and help our clients build robust mobile and web applications. Our Test Engineering technologies vary by project, so we value flexibility and willingness to learn. Our goal is to deliver amazing solutions for our clients, with quality assurance being a crucial part of that process.

Responsibilities

  • Confidently deliver high-quality test strategies and implementation, applying critical thinking to products, requirements, and processes.
  • Apply various testing methodologies and collaborate on implementation.
  • Test individual stories and overall products through local and deployed builds.
  • Contribute to a test automation suite to ensure quality over time, both locally and in CI pipelines.
  • Navigate difficult conversations by providing constructive feedback to teams.
  • Identify obstacles to ensure quality and improve user experience and testing processes.
  • Be self-aware of limitations, curious to learn new solutions, and receptive to feedback.
  • Adapt to changing priorities with positive energy.
  • Communicate and simplify complex problems to foster understanding across multidisciplinary teams.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of test engineering experience.
  • Experience with testing methodologies and automation.
  • Professional programming experience.
  • Experience with Playwright (preferred) or Cypress.
  • Utilizing Git, GitHub, and maintaining GitHub actions.
  • Comfortable using terminal and CLI tools.
  • Proficiency in Typescript.
  • Experience with Docker for local building and testing.
  • Collaborating directly with developers to troubleshoot and resolve problems.
  • Ability to evaluate requirements and identify testing gaps.
  • Ability to manage tickets and priorities in a fast-paced agile environment.
  • Advocate of SDLC processes.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.

Bonus Points

  • Mac experience (preferred).
  • Experience with Jira.
  • Familiarity with Vercel.
  • Familiarity with GCP.
  • Familiarity with Firebase and Firestore.

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products impacting millions. Our global reach allows collaboration with diverse teams, solving complex problems and delivering impactful tech solutions.

We focus on engineering excellence, using the latest in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile, CI/CD, and DevOps-first approaches to scale solutions effectively.

As part of an international and innovative consultancy, you will have:

  • A Global Innovation Hub: Be part of an international tech leader.
  • Work-Life Balance: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy.
  • Cutting-Edge Technologies: Engage with the latest innovations.
  • Prestigious Partnerships: Collaborate with renowned brands.
  • Growth Opportunities: Clear career development paths.
  • Global Exposure: Optional international travel.

Our benefits include:

  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Life insurance.
  • Monthly vouchers for meals, culture, education, health, and mobility.
  • Child care assistance and more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to diversity and inclusion. All hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merits, and performance. We do not discriminate based on characteristics related to diversity.

We only use your data for application processing and statistics, and do not request sensitive personal information.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.
Essa posição é para atuar em modelo híbrido.
Who will you be working with?
In this role, you will be working with our best-in-class IT Operations team, which drives operational excellence and continued automation in supporting business applications. This role will develop break-fix solutions and enhancements to reduce ticket volume and automate repeatable support tasks. This role will partner with key functional stakeholders, product team members, and support to develop deep technical domain expertise within the global operations applications.
How will you make a difference?
As a member of the Global IT Operations Support team, you will provide technical expertise leveraging the DevOps methodology, including Kubernetes, Docker, SDLC, CI/CD, Cloud, Microservice Design, and Monitoring. You will be responsible for supporting and developing business applications with the technical knowledge to do so. One of the main applications this role will be supporting is the Supply Chain Connect platform application, internally developed and used for managing sourcing, fulfillment, quality, and supply base interactive processes. This application includes several interfaces. This role serves as a technical domain expert for continued maintenance and support and will ensure data quality, ongoing break-fix development, and support automation for continual improvement.
What do we want to know about you?
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or “STEM” major (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math) or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience as a Software Engineer or a Full-Stack Developer.
  • Experience in developing against HTML, CSS, Angular JS, Java, JBoss, Apache, Tomcat, J2EE, Springboot, Microservices, Restful Webservices, Postgres PL/SQL.
  • Experience with Linux, CI/CD, AWS, Terraform.
  • Experience with Informatica or Appworx, Swagger, and Postman or Akana.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver business needs on timeline.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Highly self-motivated, disciplined, and a team player.
  • Demonstrated experience in operations support.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.

What will your typical day look like?
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and problems for multiple applications in ServiceNow.
  • Facilitate outages with bridge calls, pull in required resources/skillsets, and communicate updates
  • Work along with the Support team to coordinate advanced troubleshooting techniques on critical, highly complex user problems
  • Resolve incidents and service requests for L3 level issues
  • Design, develop, test, communicate, and deploy break-fixes and prevent the recurrence of issues
  • Create change requests, implementation plans, and rollback plans for developed changes
  • Identify and execute on the development of automation opportunities to drive efficiencies in support
  • Understanding of best coding practices, adhering to all the software architectural and Security standards
  • Assist, guide, and troubleshoot with the Support team to resolve customer issues of a technical nature
  • Work with teams through Agile development practices
  • Conduct daily calls with the Support & Development team to drive faster resolution and escalate during SLA misses.
  • Drive KPI metrics for the applications in support and have weekly calls with Functional teams to showcase the metrics.
  • Perform user access and audit reviews for the applications.
  • Queue ticket management to ensure incidents are resolved on a priority basis.
  • Align to security controls, mitigate and resolve security risks, and complete security reviews.
  • Document standard operating procedures for issue resolution to provide to L1/L2 support resources
  • Collaborate with IT teams to ensure data quality of interfaces for data moving between systems
  • Facilitate deployment and release activities, including communication and additional support coverage
  • Develop and update chef scripts.

Who are we?
Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more! Commitment to Embrace Diversity:
Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.
To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.
We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. title: Microservices Engineer
description:
3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps.
Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. They are also central to the health of critical infrastructure across the globe. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users.
While Ubuntu has been enormously successful and in many senses leads the industry, we think we can substantially improve our practices, quality and performance in the web services domain. We are growing our teams, and in doing so we aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices.
Key areas of interest for us are:

  • API design, documentation, and governance
  • Database performance design considerations and skills
  • Multi-region service delivery for resilience and performance
  • Fuzzing and other proactive security analysis techniques
  • Tracing and profiling for distributed systems insights
  • Next-generation DevOps practices
Location : we have microservices teams with open roles in every time zone.
What your day will look like
  • Write high-quality, well-designed, and robust software that works at scale
  • Design APIs and software architecture for collegial review
  • Write tests that validate software behaviour
  • Build and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant applications and services
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality solutions to resolve them
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Discuss, contribute to, and collaborate across teams at Canonical
  • Work from home with global travel twice annually for company events
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Proficiency in Python and / or Go
  • History of writing modern, maintainable software
  • Experience with relational and non-relational database systems
  • Continuous integration and continuous delivery experience
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains
  • Experience with cross-compilation
  • Experience with hyperscale public clouds and / or private clouds
  • Experience with designing, building, and running distributed systems
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Beontag é uma multinacional que atua como um dos principais fornecedores mundiais em soluções de IoT, materiais gráficos e etiquetas. Seu principal desafio será transformar a gestão de dados em um pilar central do processo de tomada de decisão, conectando Tecnologia e Negócio para entregar dados confiáveis, integrados e acionáveis para toda a organização — com especial foco na liderança executiva.

  • Criar pipeline de dados globais para integrar os diferentes ERP no Datalake

  • Garantir a segurança e disponibilidade dos dados por meio de redundâncias e escalabilidade

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência com Power BI, Pentaho e Azure
  • Desejável experiência em Tableau, IntelliDash
  • Experiência em Metodologia Ágil, utilização de ferramentas como Jira, DevOps, etc.
  • Conhecer algumas linguagens de desenvolvimento: Python, SQL, MongoDB, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Apache Kafka, Webservices SOAP, APIs de Integração REST, Desenvolvimento em Scripts Bash/AWK

DESCRIÇÃO

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Coordenadora de Estratégia para fazer parte do time da Tastemakers! Se você é apaixonado(a) por comunicação e Brand PR, tem um olhar apurado para tendências e gosta de transformar insights em ideias estratégicas e inovadoras, essa vaga é para você. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com marcas incríveis, explorar benchmarks criativos e trabalhar com uma equipe plural para construir campanhas que façam a diferença.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Profissional com experiência consolidada em estratégia e planejamento, que atua como um ponto de referência dentro do time. Possui uma visão ampla de mercado, forte capacidade analítica e criativa, e é capaz de liderar projetos multidisciplinares com autonomia. É o elo entre as equipes e os clientes, garantindo alinhamento e execução impecável das estratégias.

  1. Respeitar as datas e cronogramas de entregas e as fases dispostas no processo.
  2. Trazer para a área insights e sugestões estruturados compondo com visões inovadoras.
  3. Administrar o briefing, debriefs e refações de materiais conforme as necessidades da TMKRS ou dos clientes, seguindo os cronogramas de entregas e as fases dispostas no processo.
  4. Habilidade para liderar equipes e influenciar decisões de forma assertiva.
  5. Perfil visionário, com foco em resultados e inovação.

REQUISITOS

  • Elaboração Estratégica:
  • Desenvolver e apresentar estratégias que orientem campanhas e ações de Brand PR.
  • Criar planos de comunicação que equilibrem inovação, criatividade e foco nos objetivos das marcas.
  • Mapear tendências e comunidades conectadas às jornadas do consumidor para guiar o desenvolvimento de estratégias personalizadas.
  • Capacidade de validar e argumentar ideias, storytelling, mapa de influência e estratégia, sempre embasado em fatos e dados para clientes e interfaces internas.
  • Pesquisa e Análise:

title: Product Owner - Lace
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Who are we?
IOHK is a technology company focused on Blockchain research and development. We are renowned for our scientific approach to blockchain development, emphasizing peer-reviewed research and formal methods to ensure security, scalability, and sustainability. Our projects include decentralized finance (DeFi), governance, and identity management, aiming to advance the capabilities and adoption of blockchain technology globally.

We invest in the unknown, applying our curiosity and desire for positive change to everything we do. By fueling creativity, innovation, and progress within our teams, our products and services are designed for people to be fearless, to be changemakers.

About Lace:
Lace is a light wallet platform from IOG that brings together a wealth of Web3 features, from managing digital assets to accessing NFTs, DApps, and DeFi services, so you can discover and enjoy a new world of digital experiences. Securely send and receive digital assets, easily stake your ada and participate in the Cardano network, or send multiple assets to different addresses in one transaction. Lace does everything a wallet does - and more. Lace is already evolving, with many new features in the pipeline. From a DApp Store to a mobile app, digital identity solutions, and more - this is just the beginning. Learn more about Lace .

What the role involves:
As a Product Owner for the Lace Wallet, you will focus on driving the development and success of the mobile product while ensuring alignment with the overall product vision and roadmap. Reporting to the Lace Head of Product, you will work closely with engineering, design, QA, and other stakeholders to define priorities, create actionable user stories, and deliver features that enhance user satisfaction and drive adoption.

  • Collaborate with the Head of Product to define and execute the product strategy for the Lace mobile wallet.
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized product backlog, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and alignment with product goals.
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, and QA teams to plan sprints, refine requirements, and deliver mobile features on time and to a high standard.
  • Translate customer and stakeholder feedback into actionable features, improvements, and enhancements for the mobile platform.
  • Drive the definition of mobile-specific features that prioritize performance, usability, security, and user engagement.
  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and risks for the Lace mobile product.
  • Monitor, analyze, and incorporate feedback from product metrics related to usability, performance, and engagement to guide ongoing improvements and prioritize features.
  • Serve as the voice of the user, advocating for customer needs and ensuring user-centric product decisions.
  • Collaborate with marketing, customer support, and business teams to communicate product updates, gather insights, and align on go-to-market strategies.
  • Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across engineering, leadership, and external partners to ensure smooth product execution.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business, Computer Science, or Product Management is desirable but not required with equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with blockchain, fintech, or decentralized technologies is a plus.
  • Proven track record of delivering successful mobile products (iOS and Android) in an agile development environment.
  • Strong understanding of the mobile product lifecycle, including requirements gathering, development, testing, release, and ongoing optimization.
  • Experience creating and managing a product backlog with clear user stories, prioritization techniques, and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with mobile UX/UI principles and a user-centered approach to product development.
  • Experience monitoring and analyzing usability metrics (e.g., user adoption, retention, engagement) and translating insights into actionable improvements.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including engineers, designers, QA, and marketing.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate product vision and priorities to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, postHog, or similar product management tools.

Who you are:

  • User-Centric Thinking: Advocates for user needs and ensures that product decisions enhance usability, satisfaction, and engagement.
  • Backlog Management: Skilled at creating, prioritizing, and refining user stories to maximize product value and team efficiency.
  • Agile Delivery: Experienced in leading agile teams, facilitating sprint planning, and ensuring successful delivery of high-quality mobile features.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Analyzes product metrics, identifies trends, and translates usability feedback into actionable improvements.
  • Effective Communication: Clearly conveys product vision, priorities, and technical requirements to diverse stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving: Tackles challenges proactively and collaboratively to ensure smooth delivery and continuous product improvement.
  • Collaboration and Influence: Works effectively with cross-functional teams to align on goals, overcome blockers, and deliver results.

Then get ready to reimagine everything you thought wasn't possible because that's what it means to be an IOGer - we don't set limits, we break them.

description:
A Creditas é uma plataforma de serviços financeiros que a partir da casa, carro e salário oferece empréstimos, seguros e investimentos. Com 12 anos de atuação, é a maior plataforma de crédito online da América Latina e recebeu aportes de fundos internacionais, levantando mais de R$4 bilhões (US$879 milhões) em equity e com um portfólio atual de R$5,6 bilhões. Por meio da sua tecnologia proprietária oferece produtos como o empréstimo com garantia de automóvel ou imóvel, o consignado privado, benefícios corporativos e seguros. A Creditas já ultrapassou a marca de 13 milhões de solicitações de crédito, um valuation de US$3,5 bilhões e mais de 40 emissões no mercado de capitais (FIDCs, CRIs e FIIs).

Nosso time de Product Technology

É com ela que escalamos o negócio, otimizamos processos, reduzimos custos e entregamos a melhor experiência para viabilizar novas conquistas de nossos clientes.

Com tecnologia desenvolvida dentro de casa, trabalhamos com várias linguagens de programação do mercado. Ideal para quem, assim como a gente, ama se desafiar e se desenvolver na resolução de problemas reais.

Se tecnologia também é seu combustível e fazer a diferença é a sua paixão, embarque com a gente na Nave!

Quais são as responsabilidades desta vaga:

  • Você será fundamental no desenvolvimento e manutenção de nossa infraestrutura de dados, garantindo o manuseio eficiente do processamento e armazenamento de dados em grande escala, apoiando na construção da nossa Plataforma de Dados Creditas;
  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados e sistemas de banco de dados escaláveis e confiáveis, gerenciando soluções e automatizando processos, usando ferramentas como Spark, AirFlow, Redash, EMR e Redshift e garantindo a adesão às políticas de governança de dados;
  • Projetar, construir, manter e otimizar soluções na AWS, desenvolvendo soluções escalonáveis de processamento de dados, implementando processos CI/CD para essas soluções e aproveitando ferramentas de infraestrutura como código (IaC) para agilizar operações de dados e aprimorar implantações de soluções de dados;
  • Implementar soluções de dados usando tecnologias de ponta como Spark, Python e vários serviços AWS (S3, Redshift, EMR, Athena, Glue);
  • Orientar e treinar colegas engenheiros da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de crescimento e melhoria contínua;
  • Identificar e resolver deficit nas capacidades e processos da equipe para aumentar a eficiência e o sucesso da equipe.

Precisamos de alguém com :

  • Experiência em engenharia de dados e BigData.
  • Fortes habilidades de programação em Python, Java, Scala ou linguagens semelhantes;
  • Experiência prática na construção de plataformas de dados escalonáveis e pipelines de dados confiáveis usando tecnologias como Spark, Hadoop, Databricks, AWS SQS, AWS Kinesis, Kafka, etc;
  • Profundo conhecimento de processamento de dados, se sentir confortável em trabalhar com conjuntos de dados de grandes volumes e em processos de ingestão, transformação e processamento distribuído de dados em alta escala;
  • Experiência com as mais recentes tecnologias e tendências em plataformas de dados e nuvem;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados e tecnologias analíticas do setor, incluindo Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, ETL e bancos de dados relacionais;
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, você se orgulha de entregar um trabalho que se destaca pela precisão, desempenho e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo um alto padrão para a equipe e para a organização;
  • Disponibilidade para estar presencialmente em nosso escritório, em São Paulo-SP, uma vez a cada trimestre. Nos meses de encontro, a presença será por 4 dias seguidos.

Seria ótimo se você também tivesse:

  • Se sentir confortável com os blocos de construção de sistemas back-end modernos, arquitetura orientada a eventos e a capacidade de articular os prós/contras de diferentes abordagens com soluções recomendadas;
  • Se sentir confortável em trabalhar com tecnologias de conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernets…).

O processo seletivo começa na candidatura, e você passará por uma conversa com o time de Talent Acquisition, uma avaliação técnica com nosso time de desenvolvedores e, por último, uma conversa com a pessoa que será sua liderança. O tempo do processo é flexível, mas não se preocupe! Nosso time de Talent Acquisition está preparado para proporcionar a melhor experiência para você. Analisamos todos os perfis com atenção e sempre enviamos feedbacks, independentemente da etapa da candidatura. Além disso, todas as instruções são enviadas por e-mail.

Conheça nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde (SulAmérica);

  • PPR - Programa De Participação nos resultados;
  • Universidade Corporativa (Academy);

Diversidade no DNA

Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente diverso e com equidade de oportunidades. Valorizamos e respeitamos todas as diferenças, elas nos tornam mais fortes.

Promover a diversidade impacta positivamente a jornada de cada cliente. Desenvolvemos nossa flexibilidade cognitiva para resolver problemas, gerar valor e criar soluções mais inovadoras.

Para valorizar as diferenças na prática, focamos em três pilares:

  • Diversidade: Valorizamos a pluralidade e respeitamos todas as diferenças com empatia, trabalhando para garantir na Tripulação a representatividade da sociedade onde vivemos.
  • Equidade: Temos o compromisso de garantir oportunidades e condições justas para o crescimento e desenvolvimento de todas as pessoas.

What You'll Do
We are looking for a Pre-Sales Engineer to play a pivotal role in growing and supporting our Brazil wholesale, enterprise and government business. The ideal candidate will be upbeat, have the ability to communicate effectively, and have a proven background in understanding customer requirements and turning those requirements into fully defined and operational solutions, as well as providing advice for solution improvement and customer success.
This is a hybrid position: 3 days a week are required in the Sao Paulo office, 2 days working remotely.
The day-to-day
  • Design end-to-end technical and commercial solutions, including relationships with external and internal suppliers seeking for best solutions
  • Deliver articulate and compelling value propositions around Viasat products and services
  • Carefully listen and understand customer needs and explain how our offerings can address those needs
  • Establish relationships with key technical, operations, marketing, product management, and program delivery stakeholders within our clients
  • Identify new opportunities for growth and propose solutions
  • Own the customer engagement - driving the requirement gathering and scoping process and leading customer solution workshops
  • Present a persuasive business case, sound technical arguments, and a clear value proposition
  • Respond to the technical elements of RFI/RFP/RFQs
  • Conduct trials, pilots, and homologation of 3rd party and Viasat solutions with customers
  • Deliver Customer Demonstrations, Technical Presentations, Proposal Documents, Workshops, and Training
  • Provide support on contract development and negotiation
  • Be the technical focal point for customers enquires and owner of solution implementation
What You'll Need
  • BA or BS degree in Electrical or Telecommunications Engineer or related field (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)
  • A minimum of 5 years of technical pre-sales or related experience in the telecommunication satellite enterprise/wholesale/internet service provider markets
  • Experience in technical and commercial proposal elaboration, RFI/ RFP responses
  • Experience in end-to-end solution homologation and implementation support
  • Technical background in WAN and LAN solutions (VPN, MPLS, QoS, Internet Access, WiFi solution)
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences, anticipate potential objections and persuade others, often at senior levels, to adopt a different point of view and enable the decision making process
  • Careful attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and disciplined follow-up with customers
  • Advanced in oral and written skills, in both, English and Portuguese
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High tolerance for changes
  • High level of accountability
  • A willingness to travel given the location of our client base. This should cap out at no more than 30%
What Will Help You On The Job
  • Experience with satellite solutions (Vsat)
  • Desirable working experience within Brazilian carriers / telecom operators
  • Experience in product management/owner/ launch
  • Experience with Data Analytics (Tableau) and Python
  • Rigorous focus on client success
  • Motivated to learn

O que você precisa ter:

  4. Habilidade em desenvolver e realizar manutenções, além de construir rotinas complexas e críticas usando PLSQL.
  5. Domínio em integração de sistemas, incluindo Web Service SOAP, API REST e Webhooks.

Você se destacará se também tiver:

  1. Experiência com bancos de dados como Oracle e PostgreSQL, e ferramentas DBEaver e Allround Automations PL/SQL Developer.
  2. Conhecimento de Arquitetura de Software, incluindo Programação Orientada a Objetos, SOLID, Clean Code, além de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro como OWASP Top 10.
  3. Conhecimento em UI/UX e prototipação de sistemas.

Por que embarcar nessa viagem conosco?

Você estará se juntando a uma equipe que está na vanguarda da tecnologia para o mercado financeiro, em uma empresa que não só valoriza suas ideias, mas também incentiva seu crescimento profissional. Juntos, vamos além dos limites para criar soluções que não apenas atendem, mas definem o futuro do mercado financeiro.

Who will you be working with?

In this role, you will work with an international team and provide an essential part of the DevOps workflow for critical product teams to provide technical expertise and leadership in DevOps methodology including Kubernetes, Docker, SDLC, CI/CD, Cloud, Microservice Design, Agile Software Development, Application Profiling, Monitoring & Observability, and SRE response for our Digital Electronics software vertical. Your technical choices will create a pattern for other groups and products to model for the implementation of best practices and ensure a comprehensive and complete DevOps methodology for the business.

The contributions made on an individual level will significantly impact the DevOps strategy for the Wabtec business. A lump sum may be offered for relocation if the selected candidate meets eligibility requirements.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s Degree.

  • Proactively engages with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and design solutions using critical thinking and analysis skills and best practices.
  • Proactively learns new solutions and processes to address possible blockers or problems in product teams.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Support and improve tooling for continuous build, automated testing and release management.
  • Ability to build, maintain, and run workloads on Kubernetes orchestration systems using docker.
  • Knowledge and practical experience of cloud tooling and best practices (AWS preferred).
  • Make technology choices at an individual product level and has the ability to analyze and measure impact.
  • Profile build processes and identify bottlenecks.
  • Demonstrate expertise in writing scripts to automate tasks.
  • Implements Continuous Integration/Deployment build principles.
  • Provide expertise in quality engineering, test planning and testing methodology for a software project.
  • Help businesses develop an overall strategy for deploying code.
  • Be an expert at applying principles of SDLC and agile methodologies.
  • Build and maintain documentation related to build processes and product environmental configurations.
  • Other duties as assigned

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Assistência Odontológica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).

Who are we?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! description:
Latin America Equity Analyst – Energy and Utilities

Location

Business Area

Research

Ref #

10041731

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Intelligence (“BI”) is looking for an equity analyst to cover the Latin American energy and utilities sectors. BI conducts in-depth research on large and midsize companies to help stock and bond investors effectively evaluate them. We analyze the unique attributes of each business, how it competes against others in its industry and how business strategies impact financial results. Our analysts also consider the technology, regulations, and economies that shape the environment impacting these companies and the related industry impact.
BI research is a combination of written analysis supported by interactive charts and analytics created from company-reported, industry and government data. Analysts curate this data into comprehensive dashboards to support their own research and to provide Bloomberg Terminal users a platform to view and analyze the data as well. Our work gives trading and investment professionals' deep insight into where crucial industries stand today and where they may be heading next.
What’s in it for you:
You will be part of a dynamic team of analysts that author company-specific and topical analysis of companies and trends within the energy and utilities sectors in Latin America. You are entrusted to deliver high-quality and differentiated content while also curating our data offering.

We'll trust you to:

  • Leverage your sector-specific and generalist knowledge of Energy and utilities businesses to actively create research on a regular basis.
  • Monitor and interpret major company developments and identify macro themes and trends affecting the industries.
  • Manage earnings cycle, including previews and reviews.
  • Work closely with our global team of Bloomberg Intelligence analysts and strategists located in New York, London, and Asia to coordinate and collaborate on analysis.
  • Interact with investors, industry and market professionals, investor relations personnel, and senior management at target companies.
  • Work with Global Data teams to ensure data completeness and quality control for existing and new data sets of target companies.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with internal departments and external market professionals.

You need to have:

  • Substantial experience in Equity Research, specializing in one or more segments in Latin America: Energy and Utilities.
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese and Spanish is required.
  • Detailed knowledge of at least one of the related sectors in Latin America.
  • Experience interpreting financial statements and performing quantitative financial analysis.
  • Knowledge of advanced concepts, practices, and procedures of finance and accounting.
  • Strong primary research and writing skills, with a focus on content in English.
  • Strong Excel and/or python programming skills.
  • Good oral communication and presentation skills.
  • Self-starter, independent thinker and collaborative team player.
  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; CFA designation and/or MBA or other graduate degree preferred.

Como estagiário(a) na unidade de estágio em Educação Infantil, você pode ser direcionado para as funções de: Auxiliar de Sala e Aluno, Auxiliar da Administração Escolar ou Auxiliar de Professor(a)/Escriba. O direcionamento é feito de acordo com a necessidade da unidade escolar.

Responsabilidades

Como Auxiliar de Sala e Aluno, suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  1. Auxiliar os professores nas atividades diárias com crianças de 0 a 5 anos de idade ou do ensino fundamental;
  2. Auxiliar na preparação e execução de aulas, brincadeiras e projetos lúdicos;

Como Auxiliar da Administração Escolar, suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  1. Auxiliar nas atividades da unidade escolar;

  4. Auxiliar nas rotinas administrativas conforme demanda e orientação da gestão escolar.

Como Auxiliar de Professor(a)/Escriba, suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
